name: Table 90: Grinding Complications
description: Rulebook Table 90 (p.473), Floor 4: The Iron Tangle, Sandstone Line. Random complications for crawlers grinding for experience along the British-accented Sandstone Line and its tunnels.

results.name: Razor Fox lures crawlers into a trapped train car
results.description: The crawlers chase a Razor Fox into a seemingly abandoned train. The moment roughly half the crawlers are in the car, the door slams shut, and a strong group of Gross Atomizers rolls from the luggage racks, slowly drifting toward the trapped crawlers. The Razor Fox giggles and escapes through a small hole.

results.name: Shadow drains a Red Cornet
results.description: The crawlers come upon a pair of Red Cornets stalking through the tunnels. As the crawlers watch, a shadow detaches from the wall and grasps a Red Cornet. It shrivels, struggling weakly before turning gray and lunging for its compatriot. The crawlers haven't been noticed yet.

results.name: Screaming crawler buried under rubble
results.description: Another crawler screams at the top of their lungs at a Bopca, and then storms out past the PCs. A few moments go by, and there is a loud crash. Examining the source reveals the crawler is buried under rubble, a rusted bolt rolling at their feet.

results.name: Razor Foxes battle Gray Cornets
results.description: As the crawlers round a corner, they find themselves staring at a Moderate group of Razor Foxes battling against a Weak group of Gray Cornets. One of the Razor Foxes notices the crawler party and launches a shuriken at them, in an attempt to draw them into the fight.

results.name: Brain Teasers feasting on a fallen crawler
results.description: A dry rustling sounds ahead, followed by sounds of a struggle, two loud crunches, and a horrific scream that reverberates through the tunnel. Rushing ahead reveals a Weak group of Brain Teasers feasting on the brain of a fallen crawler. Another Weak group of Brain Teasers lingers nearby.

results.name: Human crawler caught by an Energy Vampire
results.description: Crawlers drawn by the sounds of screaming watch in horror as a Human crawler struggles in the grasp of an Energy Vampire and begs them for help.
